submission.justification:
Selection-S2 at 40% signal efficiency is recommended as it achieves the highest expected signal significance of 4.074σ, representing a substantial 56.3% improvement over S1 (2.606σ) and 19.1% improvement over S3 (3.42σ). 

All three strategies were systematically evaluated across the allowed efficiency range (20-80%) in 10% steps. Remarkably, all strategies peaked at the same 40% efficiency working point, indicating this is the optimal operating point for this rare process search.

While S2 employs ML-based jet substructure techniques that may introduce some systematic uncertainties compared to S1's simpler cut-based approach, the analysis confirmed that the background estimate remains robust and MC statistics are sufficient. The substantial performance gain of 56% justifies the additional complexity. S2's superior discrimination power through advanced jet substructure variables provides the best discovery potential for this rare process.

The recommended working point of 40% efficiency falls comfortably within the required 20-80% range and represents the optimal balance between signal acceptance and background rejection for all strategies, with S2 exploiting this balance most effectively.
